## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue where relevant.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check:public`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `init.md` and relevant product/design documentation updated

For visual changes, include a screenshot using public or synthetic data.
Never attach API keys, private audit reports, customer feedback, or signed URLs.
